title: Towards Enriching Design-Time Models with Evidence from Simulation and Operational Activities
abstract: arXiv:2610.13456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cyber-Physical Systems are developed through multiple model based activities, comprising several stages of development. As the development progresses through simulation, experimentation, and operation, observations of system execution may reveal missing, uncertain, or invalid design knowledge. The path from execution results to persistent design-time enrichment, however, is often implicit. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing an evidence driven workflow for systematically transferring knowledge produced during simulation and operation back into design-time models. We demonstrate the workflow using an Influence Model, a design-time artefact used to represent how design artefacts and environmental factors jointly affect system response properties, using a sign-following robot use case. We show how simulation evidence can enrich Influence Models by supporting participant pruning decisions, interaction characterisation, influence

translated_title: 利用仿真与运行活动的证据丰富设计时模型
translated_abstract: 信息物理系统是通过多个基于模型的活动开发而成的，包含多个开发阶段。随着开发过程经历仿真、实验和运行，对系统执行的观察可能揭示出缺失的、不确定的或无效的设计知识。然而，从执行结果到持久的设计时知识丰富这一路径往往是隐式的。本文针对这一挑战，提出了一种证据驱动的工作流，用于系统地将仿真和运行阶段产生的知识转移回设计时模型。我们通过一个影响模型来演示该工作流，影响模型是一种设计时工件，用于表示设计工件和环境因素如何共同影响系统响应属性，并以一个跟随标识的机器人为用例。我们展示了仿真证据如何通过支持参与者剪枝决策、交互特征刻画和影响分析来丰富影响模型。
tldr: 本文提出一种证据驱动的工作流，系统地将仿真与运行阶段产生的执行证据反馈回设计时模型（如影响模型），从而弥补从系统执行结果到持久设计知识丰富之间的隐式路径。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an evidence-driven workflow that systematically transfers knowledge gained from simulation and operational activities back into design-time models, such as Influence Models, to enrich Cyber-Physical Systems development.
